nary_nodes.label: Washington state wildfires
evidence: Wildfires have forced around 60,000 people to evacuate parts of the north-western US state of Washington, destroying hundreds of buildings and leaving thousands without power.

evidence: Three major blazes continued to burn around the city of Spokane on Monday, with officials warning the fires had not been contained.

nary_nodes.label: Mayor Brown describes situation as worst natural disaster
evidence: Spokane Mayor Lisa Brown described the situation to the BBC as "the worst natural disaster our region has faced"

nary_nodes.label: Authorities assessing damage and potential lives lost

nary_nodes.label: No deaths or injuries confirmed
evidence: No deaths or injuries have been confirmed.

nary_nodes.label: Investigators working out fire cause
evidence: Investigators have yet to work out how the blazes started.

nary_nodes.label: 16 large, uncontained wildfires in Washington
evidence: The fires in Spokane are among a total number of 16 large, uncontained wildfires on the landscape in Washington state as of Monday morning, according to the state's department of natural resources.

nary_nodes.label: NWS warned of "extremely critical" fire weather
evidence: The National Weather Service (NWS) had warned of "extremely critical" fire weather over the weekend, with strong winds and unusually dry conditions helping the flames spread rapidly.

nary_nodes.label: Flames spread rapidly
evidence: with strong winds and unusually dry conditions helping the flames spread rapidly.

nary_nodes.label: Videos show smoke and fires tearing through houses
evidence: Videos from Spokane - the second most populous city in the state - show huge plumes of smoke and roaring fires tearing through houses, as helicopters fly above trying to put out the flames.

nary_nodes.label: Helicopters trying to put out flames
evidence: helicopters fly above trying to put out the flames.

nary_nodes.label: 700 buildings destroyed
evidence: The fires have destroyed around 700 buildings, including homes, businesses and other buildings.

nary_nodes.label: 10,000 customers without power
evidence: More than 10,000 electricity customers were left without power on Sunday, according to Avista Utilities.

nary_nodes.label: Half of customers had power restored
evidence: By Monday, around half of them had their power restored.

nary_nodes.label: Governor Ferguson declares statewide emergency
evidence: Washington State Governor Bob Ferguson has declared a statewide emergency and requested federal assistance after speaking with US President Donald Trump.

nary_nodes.label: Governor Ferguson requests federal assistance
evidence: requested federal assistance after speaking with US President Donald Trump.

evidence: after speaking with US President Donald Trump.

nary_nodes.label: Fires named Spokane Complex Fires
evidence: The three fires around Spokane - Old Trails, Fairview and Autumn Lane - have been together named the Spokane Complex Fires.

nary_nodes.label: Fire jumped Spokane River
evidence: Fuelled by high winds, the fire jumped over the Spokane River at least twice, officials say.

nary_nodes.label: Official says burned area looks like "war zone"
evidence: At a news conference on Monday, one official said the burned area looks like a "war zone".

nary_nodes.label: Maj Gen Welsh compares scene to Iraq
evidence: Maj Gen Gent Welsh, who commands the state's National Guard, said the scene reminded him of his time serving in the US military in Iraq.
"I can tell you today that that's a war zone," he said. "When you finally get in there, and you finally look at the devastation and the damage."

nary_nodes.label: Officials trying to contact 14 people
evidence: Spokane County Sheriff John Nowels said that officials were trying to contact 14 people to confirm they managed to safely evacuate.

nary_nodes.label: Mayor Brown urges vigilance and patience
evidence: Speaking to the BBC, Mayor Brown said: "The most important thing is that people need to remain vigilant and be patient and comply when we ask them to be ready to evacuate or when we say it's time to evacuate."

nary_nodes.label: Forecasters warn temperatures likely to rise
evidence: Although lighter winds are expected, forecasters have warned temperatures are likely to rise again later in the week.

nary_nodes.label: Governor Ferguson issues outdoor fire ban
evidence: On Monday, Gov Ferguson issued a statewide ban on all outdoor fires.

nary_nodes.label: Commissioner Upthegrove warns of new spark risk
evidence: Commissioner of Public Lands Dave Upthegrove in a written statement: "Our firefighters are already stretched thin across the state, and with more heat and wind expected this weekend and for the rest of the summer, any new spark on our tinder dry landscapes can lead to another devastating wildfire."

nary_nodes.label: Commissioner Upthegrove urges Washingtonians to not be that spark
evidence: "I'm urging all Washingtonians to not be that spark."

evidence: with more reinforcements expected to arrive from other states in the coming days.

nary_nodes.label: Drones interfere with firefighting
evidence: Officials are reminding the public that it is illegal to fly drones near the fires, because they interfere with firefighting planes and helicopters and force them to land.

nary_nodes.label: Drones disrupted operations 26 times
evidence: Drones disrupted operations 26 times on Sunday.

evidence: Scientists have said that human-induced climate change makes the warm, dry conditions that lead to wildfires more likely - as well as leading to more frequent and intense heatwaves, and potential summer droughts.
